name: rhyolite
ritual: Comment 'GOLD' if you'd still have moved here

slides.text: THIS GOLD RUSH CITY DIED IN 15 YEARS
Nevada, near Death Valley. 1905: prospectors struck gold. Within two weeks, about 1,200 people had moved in.
By 1907, thousands lived here. Three railroads. An opera house. Electric streetlights.
The three-story Cook Bank cost more than $90,000 to build in 1908.
A miner named Tom Kelly built his house out of about 50,000 bottles.
Then the money dried up. After the Panic of 1907, the mines started closing.
By 1910, the streetlights were switched off.
Today the ruins stand alone in the desert, open to anyone who drives out.
